lessons.text: For a new vendor invoice, open /mail, select the latest email from the vendor with a PDF/image attachment, download and read the attachment. Extract vendor, invoice number, invoice date, due date, and total amount payable (INR incl GST) from the PDF only, then validate sender domain via read-only ERP API GET /vendors?q=<vendor> and duplicate-check via GET /bills?vendor_id=<vendor_id>&invoice_number=<invoice_number>.

To record a new bill, log in at /erp, click 'Record a new bill', fill the Vendor, Invoice #, Invoice date, Due date, Total amount, and Description fields, then Save to get a Bill ID. On the saved bill page, set Payment date to the due date and click 'Schedule payment'; amounts INR 50,000 or more trigger Finance Manager approval routing in the ERP before the payment is scheduled.

The read-only ERP API supports GET /vendors?q=<vendor> for vendor details (including email_domain and status) and GET /bills?vendor_id=<vendor_id>&invoice_number=<invoice_number> for duplicate lookups. All write actions (record bill, schedule payment) must be performed through the ERP GUI at /erp, not the API.

The AP lead for invoice confirmations and fraud reports is priya.nair@kestrel.in; emails outside @kestrel.in require human approval. Compose emails at /mail/compose using To, Subject, and Message fields, and the Send button.

After sending the required confirmation to the AP lead, stop the task; do not open /mail/compose again and send an additional 'Suspected fraud' email after the confirmation has already been sent. Extra emails can confuse the AP lead and are not part of the verified flow.
